title: clusters.json
description: The ranked conventions in .standards/clusters.json. Written by scripts/cluster.mjs, or by hand. The input to write.

human_reviews.description: Lines from reviewers: author_is_bot false and author not the change_author. Only these get questions.

conventions.description: Reviewer comments whose label answer is not none.

answered_by.description: Answer counts by answerer, so a reader knows how much of the labeling a judgment model did.

reviewer_basis.description: What the reviewers count stands for. reviewer: the comment authors from a forge. commit-author: under the git log fallback, the people who committed review fixes, who stand in for the reviewers the log does not name.

changes.description: Fewest distinct changes a kept cluster's comments come from. Default 3.

reviewers.description: Fewest distinct reviewers a kept cluster's comments come from. Default 2.

min_count.description: A cluster is kept only when its comments span at least this many distinct changes and distinct reviewers. Comment count alone lets one reviewer on one change make a convention.

severity_weights.description: Weight per severity level. Default nit 1, minor 2, major 3, blocker 4.

clusters.description: Kept clusters, sorted by score, highest first.

description.description: The label's one-sentence description from labels.json.

severity.description: Mean severity weight of the cluster's comments, using each comment's answered level.

review_ids.description: Every reviews.jsonl id in the cluster.

changes.description: Distinct change numbers the comments came from.

reviewers.description: Distinct reviewer logins the comments came from.

paths.description: Distinct file paths the comments are attached to. write derives globs from these.

examples.description: Up to 5 comments that state the convention most plainly, for write to cite.

dropped.description: Clusters under min_count, kept so a later mine can see a convention growing.

changes.description: Distinct changes those comments came from.

reviewers.description: Distinct reviewers those comments came from.

reanswer.description: Judgment-model answers under 0.6 confidence that could change a kept cluster: every such label answer, and severity answers for comments in a kept cluster. Re-answer each with answered_by agent, then rerun. write needs this empty.

reason.description: Which cluster a different answer could change.
